records.statement: BNY's support for XRP custody proves institutional safekeeping access for eligible clients, not XRP purchases, net inflows, collateral acceptance, customer balances or use of XRP as a reserve asset.
BNY's intended XRPL tokenized-asset support and direct RLUSD mint/redeem are future plans subject to final BNY and regulatory approvals.
C2FO's more-than-$520B figure relates to existing Early Pay programs. It is not Instant Pay financing volume, XRPL transaction volume or capital newly committed to XRP.

The announced Instant Pay settlement asset is RLUSD. No evidence in the announcement shows XRP being used as the bridge asset or a material XRP purchase requirement; native XRP network fees/reserves are a separate, much smaller mechanism.

Coinbase stated that RLUSD collateral functionality for Coinbase Global Exchange customers would follow. The October 28 announcement establishes retail/Prime/Exchange access and network deposits/withdrawals, not live global-exchange collateral acceptance.
Coinbase's RLUSD listing and support for XRPL transfers do not establish that Coinbase purchased XRP, increased XRP inventory or uses XRP as collateral for RLUSD.

Ripple's $900M annualized product-revenue target, $16T enabled product transactions and $150B lifetime payments-volume claim are company-wide product metrics; they are not audited XRPL transaction volume, XRP trading volume or XRP-holder value capture.

OCC CAS confirms Ripple National Trust Bank became consummated/effective on 2026-10-26. It does not establish opening to customers, balances, reserve migration or operational service volumes. RLUSD remains issued by Standard Custody & Trust Company per Ripple's release.

Circle's $12.442B USDC-on-platform figure is Circle's own platform measure for Q2; Coinbase's $8.616B USDC AOP is Coinbase's point-in-time measure at Q3-end. They are not additive or directly comparable. Circle's $655.3M H1 distribution cost is not Coinbase revenue/profit.

Arc is Circle's separate Layer-1 network with USDC gas. SBI's validator role and Coinbase's exchange-access role must not be confused with XRPL participation, and do not establish XRP collateral on Arc.
SBI/Startale and Coinbase participation in Open Standard, and exploration of JPYSC/OUSD interoperability, do not establish a bilateral SBI-Coinbase contract or live production interoperability.

The ChatGPT/generative-AI event is hosted by Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd. It is not SBI Holdings, SoftBank or OpenAI, and the seminar does not establish an OpenAI partnership.
The Ripple-Robinhood announcement adds RLUSD, XRPL institutional settlement and Ripple Prime services, but discloses no XRP purchase, collateral amount or realized transaction volume.

BNY, C2FO, Coinbase, Robinhood and Ripple announcements were clustered around Ripple Swell on October 26–28. Their timing and shared issuer narrative create dependence; do not count each announcement as an independent causal shock or independent corroboration.

Alpha Finance covers five funds; XRP Insights covers six spot funds plus BITW; Maketo's five-fund series has its own method. Their totals must not be averaged or summed. The captured data end at the October 29 U.S. session.
Seandra's 22:45 UTC observation is Binance USDT perpetual only. It does not represent cross-exchange open interest; long-account share is not notional exposure, and funding is venue/period-specific.
